what: Plan-review external prompts are authored in the renderer heredoc, not in plan-review.md
scenario_or_breakage: Updating plan-review.md with a reviewer style line does not change prompts written by dispatch-plan-review-panel.sh (static slots and dynamic tail via append_shared_prompt_tail); Step 3 externals stay on the current dense prompt
suggested_fix: Add an UPDATED subsection for render-plan-review-prompt.sh (inject readability guidance or <READABILITY_STYLE> plus substitution) and extend test-plan-review-prompt.sh; keep plan-review.md changes only if they document the renderer contract
